title: continuous-batcher: scheduler tuning for queueing fairness and starvation prevention (timeouts)
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: customer workloads and internal canaries showed increased latency tail and a small fraction of requests experiencing starvation when continuous-batcher queues grew under mixed short/long sequence workloads. This PR tunes the scheduler to improve queueing fairness, add proactive starvation prevention, and unify timeout semantics to avoid excessive waiting while preserving batching benefits. Changes include: 1) introduce a per-request enqueue timestamp and dynamic aging weight used by the scheduler to prioritize older requests across lanes; 2) add a configurable max_queue_time_ms and an enforcement path that moves requests to a high-priority lane if they exceed the threshold to avoid starvation; 3) tighten lane admission logic to cap lane depth for long-sequence-heavy lanes and enable cross-lane stealing for short requests; 4) add metrics and tracing hooks (batcher.queue_time_ms_p90/p99, batcher.starved_requests, batcher.preempt_evictions) and a series of unit and integration tests; 5) minor API: new BatchSchedulerConfig fields (max_queue_time_ms, aging_factor, lane_depth_cap) with defaults chosen to be conservative for existing customers. Performance: microbench results on a mixed workload (20% long seq, 80% short seq) show 35% reduction in p99 queueing latency and zero observed starved requests in 1h canary across 4 regions. Rollout: feature-flag gated, gradual rollout plan to Dedicated clusters with canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% and full monitoring dashboards + automated rollback alert if starved_requests > 0 for 10m. Backcompat: defaults preserve current behavior. See linked Linear tickets for evaluation artifacts and tuning notes.

release_notes: Improve continuous-batcher scheduler fairness and starvation prevention by introducing aging-based prioritization, max_queue_time_ms enforcement, lane depth caps, and cross-lane stealing. Adds new config knobs: max_queue_time_ms, aging_factor, lane_depth_cap, stealing_cooldown_ms. Provides metrics batcher.queue_time_ms_p90/p99, batcher.starved_requests, and tracing hooks. Rollout gated by feature flag and gradual canary.
